title: Customer proxy fallback and staged kickstart triage for air-gapped/on-prem intake
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: Customers requesting private/VPC/on-prem deployments frequently hit two categories of blockers during intake: (1) strict air-gapped networks or transit policies that prohibit outbound vendor connections, and (2) intermittent upgrade windows or kernel/host patch constraints that prevent us from running full validation agents during onboarding. These blockers cause long intake cycles and high touch from solutions and eng. Goal: Design a triage lane that (a) quickly classifies inbound requests by their networking posture and upgrade flexibility, (b) suggests deterministic fallbacks such as a customer-managed proxy-bridge, staged kickstart installation, or read-only preflight probes, and (c) returns a prioritized path with clear SLAs for response and delivery. This ticket defines the product requirements, scoring rubric, and operator flows for a new "proxy fallback / staged kickstart" intake lane.
acceptance_criteria: A scoring rubric is published and applied to all new private/VPC/on-prem intake requests that classifies network posture (open outbound, limited proxy allowed, fully air-gapped) and upgrade window (flexible, scheduled window only, no upgrades allowed)
For each classification, a recommended triage path exists: self-serve proxy template, staged kickstart checklist, or concierge-only onboarding with timeline estimate
Solution runbook and customer-facing intake questionnaire are published in Confluence and linked from the intake form
SLA targets defined: response within 2 business days for 'limited proxy' and 5 business days for 'fully air-gapped' to move to an initial kickoff or escalate
Pilot completed with 3 recent enterprise customers (one per classification) and feedback captured
Telemetry added to the intake form: time-to-kickoff, handoffs count, and reasons for escalation
deliverables: Intake questionnaire update (UI + API) with network posture and upgrade window fields
Scoring rubric doc and decision map (Confluence)
Self-serve proxy-bridge template repo and customer instructions (Drive + GitHub)
Staged kickstart installer checklist and minimal validation agent mode
Concierge onboarding SLA sheet and escalation playbook
